verdict.rationale: The Card Expenses API only retrieves already-approved expenses and lets you mark them synced after ingestion into ERP/accounting systems; there is no evidence of automatic receipt capture (e.g. receipt scanning, OCR, or auto-coding) triggered at the moment of card use. No mention of receipt matching or AI-driven auto-coding of transactions. Missing for 10: receipt capture mechanism (photo/OCR ingestion), automatic categorization/coding logic, and any real-time trigger tied to card swipe.
